name: ecommerce-monorepo
description: E-commerce platform: user-portal (storefront) + admin-portal (control center) + mobile apps, all on one Supabase PostgreSQL database.

scripts.dev: cd user-portal && bun run dev 2>&1 | tee ../dev.log
scripts.dev:admin: cd admin-portal && bun run dev 2>&1 | tee ../admin-dev.log
scripts.lint: cd user-portal && bun run lint && cd ../admin-portal && bun run lint
